data.name: Amitabh
data.gender_notes: Amitabh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + mita, 'measured', + bhā, 'light' — 'of boundless splendour'. Its root is Sanskrit a + mita + bhā. A classical Sanskrit epithet; also a Buddha's name. Amitabh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Boundless splendour; immeasurable light”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Amitabh expresses “Boundless splendour; immeasurable light”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + mita, 'measured', + bhā, 'light' — 'of boundless splendour'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amitabh total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
